methods.steps: Open the DOCX in Writer, File > Export As > Export as PDF, then gs -sDEVICE=tiff24nc -r300 -o 'report-%03d.tif' report.pdf
methods.limits: Two-stage pipeline; tiff24nc writes 24-bit RGB and %03d numbers the page files. Run locally on a sample PDF.

methods.steps: In Pages on Mac, File > Open the DOCX, File > Export To > PDF, then magick -density 200 report.pdf report.tiff
methods.limits: ImageMagick reads PDF through Ghostscript. Run locally on a sample PDF.

methods.steps: Add the DSS file (Add button or File > Add); choose MP3 in the Output Format field; click Convert.
methods.limits: DSS input is listed among the formats only the paid Switch Plus supports, and in its trial.

methods.steps: Drag the DSS file in; choose MP3 in the Output Format menu; set the folder with Browse; click Convert.
methods.limits: Windows desktop program.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i memo.dss -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 160k memo.mp3
methods.limits: FFmpeg decodes DSS Standard Play. Run locally on the sample DSS fixture.

methods.steps: In Inkscape with Ink/Stitch: File > Open the DST (Manual Stitch Mode), File > Export PNG Image; open the PNG in GIMP, File > Export As with a .jpg extension.
methods.limits: Embroidery interpretation then PNG/JPEG stages; JPEG contains no stitch instructions.

methods.steps: Select the design in My Designs, more actions menu (3 dots), Capture Design Bitmap; download the PNG; magick sample.png approval.jpeg
methods.limits: Library account required. Run the magick command locally.

methods.steps: import pyembroidery; p = pyembroidery.read_dst('sample.dst'); pyembroidery.write_png(p, 'sample.png'); then open the PNG in GIMP and File > Export As with a .jpg extension.
methods.limits: README documents read_dst and write_png.

methods.steps: Open the EXR; File > Export As; end the file name in .jpeg; Export; set the quality in the JPEG dialog.
methods.limits: GIMP 2.10 added high-bit-depth EXR import. JPEG cannot hold the EXR channel and depth structure.

methods.steps: oiiotool lighting.exr -o review.jpg
methods.limits: -o writes the format of the file name; --colorconvert converts between color spaces.

methods.steps: magick lighting.exr -quality 91 review.jpeg
methods.limits: Sets the JPEG quality; run locally on the sample EXR. The formats page lists EXR and JPEG as read and write.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i album.flac -b:a 160k -c:a wmav2 album.wma
methods.limits: wmav2 is Windows Media Audio 2, not WMA Lossless. Run locally on the sample FLAC.

methods.steps: Open the FLAC (File > Open); File > Save As; pick WMA.
methods.limits: WavePad opens FLAC on Windows and Mac but saves WMA on Windows only.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i lesson.flv -c:a mp2 -c:v mpeg2video -q:v 4 lesson.mpeg
methods.limits: general.html lists FLV, MPEG-PS, MPEG-2 video and MP2 for encoding and decoding; -q is the fixed quality scale option. Run locally on the sample FLV.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i legacy.flv -ar 44100 -c:a libmp3lame -c:v flv legacy.swf
methods.limits: The SWF muxer supports FLV1 video and MP3 audio at 11025, 22050 or 44100 Hz (swfenc.c). Run locally on the sample FLV.

methods.steps: cjxl -d 0 loop.gif loop.jxl
methods.limits: Man page: accepts GIF input, compresses an image or animation, -d 0 is mathematically lossless. Ran locally on a generated GIF, exit 0.

methods.steps: Open the GIF; File > Export As; name the file .jxl; Export; the dialog has a Lossless checkbox.
methods.limits: JPEG XL export page: .jxl extension starts the export and the dialog has a Lossless checkbox.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i drawing.gif -an -c:v libx264 -crf 20 drawing.mkv
methods.limits: Ran locally on a generated GIF, exit 0, one H.264 video stream, same duration. general.html lists GIF animation and Matroska as encode and decode, libx264 as the H.264 encoder.

methods.steps: Open the GIF; click Export; click Advanced; in Format / Codec set the container to mkv; export.
methods.limits: Forum page lists mkv among container choices in Advanced Format / Codec. Features page lists GIF among supported image formats.

methods.steps: magick sequence.gif -coalesce 'frame-%04d.png'; ffmpeg -framerate 10 -i 'frame-%04d.png' -c:v libx264 frames.mkv
methods.limits: Ran both commands locally, exit 0. -coalesce documented on the command-line-options page; -framerate on the image2 demuxer in ffmpeg-formats. Replaces the GIF's own delays with one fixed rate.

methods.steps: Open the GIF; File > Export As; export it as a TIFF; in the TIFF dialog set Compression and tick Save layers to store each layer as its own page.
methods.limits: TIFF export page documents Compression and Save layers (each layer a separate page, from the bottom). Export As menu path from the Export As page.

methods.steps: Open the GIF; File > Save As; pick TIF as the format; tick Show format options dialog to set its options.
methods.limits: Format matrix shows GIF and TIF both read and save. FAQ describes File > Save As and the Show format options dialog checkbox.
